title: Implement Real-time Anomaly Detection
description:
Develop and deploy ML model for detecting water quality anomalies in real-time sensor data.

## Requirements
- Process data from 500+ sensors
- Detection latency < 5 minutes
- False positive rate < 2%

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Model achieves 98% accuracy on test data
- [ ] Integration with sensor data pipeline complete
- [ ] Alert system configured and tested
- [ ] Performance benchmarks met

## Technical Notes
- Use time-series anomaly detection algorithms
- Consider seasonal patterns in water usage
- Integrate with existing Kafka streaming infrastructure
